# RestoBoom

> RestoBoom is a growth platform for Québec restaurants (French first, English mirror): missed-call text-back in 15 seconds, one inbox for 5 channels per location, review requests with approved replies (no review gating), follow-up sequences with quiet hours, and guest profiles fed by POS data. Data is hosted in Canada; CASL (LCAP) and Québec Law 25 compliant by design; priced in CAD.

## Key facts
- Missed-call text-back in 15 seconds, in the guest's language.
- 5 channels (SMS, email, Messenger, Instagram, web chat), one inbox per location.
- The automated front desk discloses that it is automated.
- Every guest gets the Google review link, whatever the rating (no gating). Suggested replies require owner approval.
- Follow-ups respect quiet hours 9 pm–9 am; STOP/ARRET unsubscribes instantly; consent checked before every send.
- Guest profiles fed by POS data; CSV import from day one. Your phone number stays the same.
- Pricing (CAD, monthly, GST/QST extra): Solo $149 (1 location, $499 setup), Multi $449 (up to 5 locations, $1,499 setup), Franchise $1,299 (network, $4,999 setup).
